title: Initials
description:
Write `std::string initials(std::string_view first, std::string_view last)` that builds a person's initials with full stops:

```cpp
initials("Ada", "Lovelace")   // "A.L."
```

`first[0]` is the first character of a string. A `std::string` grows when you add characters or text to it with `+=`.
hints: Start with an empty `std::string result{};` and append four things to it, one at a time.
